name: Leaderboard climb
summary: Optional two-line title over a ranked table. Your highlighted row jumps up slot by slot on beats while passed rows slide down; ranks and your record update; at the top the title's last word rolls to a new word and a trophy pops in.

params.title: { lines: [line1, line2], swap: 'word' } or null
params.rows: [{ name, rec }] the other entries in order
params.me: { name, badge, recs: [record at each rank state] }
params.jumps: [{ at, from, to }] slot indexes (0 = first)
params.layout: { left, width, titleTop, titleSize, cardTop, rowH }
params.cues: { in, swap (defaults to the last jump), out }
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as climb from '../blocks/ranked-climb/index.mjs';
const table = climb.create(ctx, { title: { lines: ['Win your', 'week.'], swap: 'league.' }, rows, me, jumps, cues: { in: CUE.climb, out: CUE.logo - 0.2 } });
changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the DraftKit showreel standings climb

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
